records.text: haiha ki asilu, haiha ki damuri

senses.zh: 似乎是 Asilu 或 Damuri （領先）
senses.en: It seems to be Asilu or Damuri (who is leading).

records.text: yaku haiki isiw ka, babariway xumak

senses.zh: 我像你的話，就要買房子
senses.en: If I were you, I would buy a house.
It was just like that person in height.

records.text: h iki saw a rakihan haim niai

senses.en: It seemed to be someone's baby.

senses.zh: 她看見他似乎要蓋房子
senses.en: She saw that it looked like he was going to build a house.
He looks like a good young man.

records.text: taxaw uhuni ka haiki nisia aba pinakuas a rahan

senses.zh: 到現在似乎他父親所祝福的話都應驗了
senses.en: All his father's words seem to have materialized by now.

records.text: naki a baba mikita sabun a imini haiki kinan ezet ka, ini ezetmeken sabun ki

senses.zh: 我舅舅看到這些青草好像蛇吃過的，可是蛇卻不吃草
senses.en: My uncle found that this grass seemed to have been eaten by a snake, but a snake never ate grass.

records.text: haiki uzay ezet a daran, haiki riniux tula a daran lia la

senses.zh: 好像不是蛇走的路，好像是鰻魚爬過的
senses.en: Perhaps it was not the path of a snake; perhaps it was a path where an eel slid.
